relationships.subject: Conditioned serum
relationships.evidence_quote: A single i.t. injection of hCS produced significant reduction of mechanical allodynia for >6 weeks, as shown by increased PWT (Fig. 2A) and reduced PWF (Fig. 2B), compared to hNCS.

relationships.object: Spinal cord dorsal horn astrocytes and microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared to rNCS, the rCS treatment resulted in significant decreases in GFAP immunostaining (p<0.05, t-test, Fig. 5C) and IBA1 immunostaining (p<0.01, t-test, Fig. 5D).

relationships.subject: TGF-β1
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared to control IgG, TGF-β1 neutralizing antibody significantly but transiently decreased PWT at 1 hour

relationships.subject: TIMP-1
relationships.evidence_quote: As an endogenous inhibitor of MMP-9, TIMP1 has been shown to potently suppress nerve injury-induced neuropathic pain in rodents

relationships.subject: Exosomes
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, these findings suggest that exosomes are critically required for sustained pain relief by CS.

key_findings: Single intrathecal conditioned serum (human, rat, mouse) gave weeks-long relief of paclitaxel mechanical allodynia in both sexes and reduced spinal GFAP/IBA1.
CS had higher IL-1Ra, TIMP-1, TGF-β1 and RvD2; exosome depletion largely abolished sustained analgesia.
